title: Withings BPM dead
fullDescription:
Withings BPM Connect/Core/Vision uses internal Li-ion. Dead unit usually means depleted battery; charge via USB-C or micro-USB for 30 minutes minimum.

If no charge LED, try a different cable.
whenToCallPro: If LED never lights — battery may be dead permanently.

title: Cuff/Air leak error
fullDescription:
Err1 means the cuff couldn't reach pressure or hose disconnected. Check the cuff fit (snug but one finger gap), inspect for hose kinks, and look for tears in the bladder.

Reposition cuff and retry.

fixSteps.title: Reposition cuff
fixSteps.instruction: 1-2cm above elbow, snug, one finger fit.

fixSteps.title: Inspect hose
fixSteps.instruction: Straighten any kinks; verify connection seated.

fixSteps.title: Bladder check
fixSteps.instruction: Listen for air hissing during inflation.

faq.a: Withings ships universal 22-42cm; verify fits your arm.

title: Motion error during measurement
shortDescription: Patient moved or talked during reading.
fullDescription:
Err2 fires when accelerometer detects arm/body motion during the inflation/deflation phase. Sit still, feet flat, support arm at heart level, and don't talk.

Not a fault.

fixSteps.title: Re-position
fixSteps.instruction: Sit upright, feet flat, support arm.

faq.a: Atrial fibrillation can also trigger Err2.

title: Pulse signal too weak
fullDescription:
Err3 means oscillometric sensor couldn't measure pulse — usually cuff loose, cuff over clothing, or arm cold.

Warm arm, place cuff on bare skin, retry.

fixSteps.title: Bare skin
fixSteps.instruction: Cuff directly on skin, not sleeve.

whenToCallPro: If Err3 persists across multiple sessions, see physician.

faq.a: Yes — try other arm if persistent.

title: Reading outside displayable range
shortDescription: BP either too high or too low for sensor.
fullDescription:
Err4 fires when measured systolic <40 or >250 mmHg. Either positioning is wrong or there is an actual hypertensive emergency.

Reposition and retry; if persists, seek medical help.
whenToCallPro: If repositioning doesn't clear the reading.
videoSearchQuery: Withings BPM Err4 out of range

faq.a: Sustained systolic >180 or diastolic >120 = call emergency services.

title: BPM won't pair to Health Mate
fullDescription:
Withings BPM uses BLE to sync via Health Mate app. Pairing fails when the phone has stale pair, location permission off, or the BPM is in shipping-mode (factory).

Factory reset: hold start 30 seconds.

faq.a: BPM Core/Vision support Wi-Fi after first BLE pair.

title: BPM Connect can't reach Wi-Fi
fullDescription:
BPM Connect/Core uploads via Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz only). Cloud icon with X shown when SSID changed, password changed, or network is 5 GHz only.

Reconfigure Wi-Fi via Health Mate app.

fixSteps.title: Disable captive portal
fixSteps.instruction: If on hotel/guest Wi-Fi, BPM cannot authenticate.

faq.a: Readings sync via BLE when phone nearby.

title: BPM Core ECG signal lost
fullDescription:
BPM Core takes a 30-second ECG via finger electrode. Lost-signal happens when finger is dry, off the electrode, or when patient moved.

Moisten finger lightly and grip electrode firmly.

fixSteps.title: Grip electrode
fixSteps.instruction: Firm grip on metal contact during full 30s.

whenToCallPro: If repeated ECG fails, contact Withings.
videoSearchQuery: Withings BPM Core ECG signal lost

faq.a: FDA-cleared for AFib detection — not a diagnostic ECG.

title: BPM Core stethoscope reading weak
fullDescription:
BPM Core records heart sounds during cuff deflation. Weak signal from loose cuff, hairy arm under cuff, or noisy room.

Quiet room, bare skin, snug cuff.

title: BPM stuck mid-firmware
fullDescription:
If a firmware update is interrupted, BPM may reboot in DFU loop. Hold start 60 seconds while plugged in to force factory recovery.

Open Health Mate; firmware will retry.
